description: Review feedback fixes: move currentProviderMode into _sessionState, add minLen to validateString, rate-limit injection error toasts
steps: In src/utils/gemini.js, remove standalone `let currentProviderMode = 'byok';` and add `providerMode: 'byok'` to _sessionState. Update all references. Add providerMode reset in resetSessionState(). Remove redundant assignments in close paths.
In src/index.js, add minLen parameter to validateString. Update api-keys:add validation for label to allow null/undefined labels.
In src/utils/renderer.js, add rate-limiting to the typing-injection-error toast (max 1 per 5 seconds).
acceptance_criteria: No standalone currentProviderMode variable exists in gemini.js
Injection error toasts are rate-limited to 1 per 5 seconds
findings: All 3 issues fixed. currentProviderMode fully migrated to _sessionState.providerMode (22 references updated). validateString now requires minLen=1 by default. api-keys:add allows null/undefined labels gracefully. Injection error toasts rate-limited to 1 per 5 seconds. Redundant providerMode='byok' assignments removed from close paths since resetSessionState() handles the reset.
